name: rmsnorm_hf
description: HuggingFace LlamaRMSNorm semantics: for each row x and one-dimensional weight w, y = cast(x * rsqrt(mean(x^2, dim=-1) + eps), input.dtype) and out = cast(w * y, out_dtype). The mean and normalization are computed in float32, but y is rounded to input.dtype before the weight multiply, unlike fused_rmsnorm. The output dtype is weight.dtype when it equals input.dtype, otherwise torch.promote_types(weight.dtype, input.dtype). Returns a newly allocated tensor of the input shape and does not mutate inputs. Suites exercise bfloat16 input/weight with eps=1e-6.
